description: Satellite imagery displays a rugged coastline separating land from open water, illustrating the definition of coastal waters for land monitoring and environmental regulation. The land features appear in false colour, with reds indicating vegetated or terrestrial areas and light blue hues along the immediate coastline. The open water is represented by dark blue to black tones. A distinct yellow line precisely delineates the jagged coastline, marking the boundary between land and sea. The classification code "8.4.2.0" is visible in the upper right quadrant of the open water. This image visually supports the definition of coastal waters as described by the Water Framework Directive (Directive 2000/60/EC), which extends one nautical mile seaward from the baseline.
